# mux_live_stream_playback_id (Resource)

A playback ID of a live stream: what viewers play it through, at `https://stream.mux.com/<id>.m3u8`. Changing any argument replaces the playback ID, which changes its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mux_live_stream" "channel" {
  title = "Main channel"
}

resource "mux_live_stream_playback_id" "public" {
  live_stream_id = mux_live_stream.channel.id
  policy         = "public"
}

output "playback_url" {
  value = "https://stream.mux.com/${mux_live_stream_playback_id.public.id}.m3u8"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `live_stream_id` (String) ID of the live stream, e.g. `mux_live_stream.example.id`.
- `policy` (String) `public` (anyone with the URL can play), `signed` (playback needs a token signed with a signing key) or `drm` (needs `drm_configuration_id`).

### Optional

- `drm_configuration_id` (String) ID of the DRM configuration, for the `drm` policy only. `data.mux_drm_configurations` lists the environment's.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The playback ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <live_stream_id>/<playback_id>.
terraform import mux_live_stream_playback_id.public ZEBrNTpHC02iUah025KM3te6ylM7W4S4silsrFtUkn3Ag/HNRDuwff3K2VjTZZAPuvd2Kx6D01XUQFv02GFBHPUka018
```
